testcase.name: custom patterns and multiple ticket requirements use submitted marks
corrupted proof award and premature completion are rejected
computers submit under the same call window without revealing future numbers
a closed prize cannot be claimed on a later number
separate submissions never combine unmarked numbers into a new prize
human prizes require a real valid claim and retry is idempotent
only owned called marks can be submitted
terminal house keeps its call window open and stops before another number
undo removes claims for the removed call and preserves restored state
successive ranked houses use fresh tickets on later calls
same call ties are independent of arrival order and points are not per ticket
computer and human share a terminal house on the same number
ranked houses cannot skip rank or reuse a completed ticket
